# Internal Execution Brief

Use one brief for each concrete non-trivial task. Complete the fields from
local evidence before implementation and keep the brief as task-instance
working data. This reference is not a skill format, design or state machine,
second implementation plan, persisted state document, packet schema, or
separate approval gate.

## Lifecycle Notes

- Same-session work keeps the brief in working context.
- Pause or resume may materialize exactly one uncommitted disposable
  `tmp/briefs/<slug>.md`.
- Promotion to a retained implementation plan transfers authority to
  `/internal-gateway-writing-plans` and retires this brief as authority.
- Supporting skills may provide evidence but may not create competing briefs.
- Before live provider or external operations, record explicit authority and a
  safe local fallback; otherwise stop fail-closed.
- Closeout uses one canonical evidence ledger with fresh focused and broader
  validation evidence. Do not add numeric thresholds or tool-call quotas.
